parameters.name: CertificateId
parameters.description: The ID of the SSL certificate that you want to delete. The ID is automatically generated by the system and globally unique.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi delete-domain-certificate --group-id 927d50c0f2e54b359919923d908bb015 --domain-name api.demo.com --certificate-id c621720d1eb34843822b7fb5148e6926 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
